sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner wanted a residential plot for construction of his house and he approached the respondent no.4- E- Square Homes Private Ltd. which claimed that it had purchased the land of Village Sithauli Khurd, Mohari Kalan, pargana and tehsil Mohanlalganj, Lucknow from their respective owners.

After purchase of such land from the original tenure holders, the respondent no.4 had also taken permission for changing the nature of agricultural land for non-agircultural purpose under the provisions of Section 143 of the U.P. Z.A.
& L.R. Act from the Competent Authority.
The said land was developed by plotting it for residential purposes.

The petitioner purchased a residential plot No. H-83, Block-H, measuring an area of 1000 (one thousand) square feet having a consideration of Rs. 3,00,000/-(Three lakhs) which is part and parcel of land of Khasra No. 3 Min & 1 Min, situated at village Sithauli Khurd, Mohari Kalan,
pargana & tehsil Mohanlalganj, Lucknow, from the opposite party No. 4, through registered sale deed dated 31.07.2014.

Later on some agreement took place between the respondent nos.2 and 3 with the respondent no.4 and now the petitioner has come to know that Khasra No.1 and Khasra No.3 of Village Sithauli Khurd, from which the petitioner's plot no. A-5 has been carved out, is also being acquired.
A public notice was issued on 29.12.2021 inviting the objections from the recorded tenure holders on 04.01.2022.

The respondent no.4 called a meeting of all the plot holders including the petitioner and asked the petitioner to surrender the sale deed in favour of the company and also to execute the Power of Attorney in favour of the respondent no.4 and it was also revealed that the company respondent no.4 has already executed the agreement with the respondent no.2 under the U.P. Land Pooling Policy.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner purchased a plot of 1000 sq. ft for a residential purpose in an already developed area by the respondent no.4 and the petitioner will get only 250 sq. ft of plot area under the agreement entered into between the respondent no.4 and respondent nos.2 & 3.

The petitioner has sent a representation to the respondent no.2, where he has not challenged the acquisition but he has prayed that compensation Priyanshu Rastogi (Minor) Thru.His ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48200830/
2 be provided as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 2013").

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The apprehension of the petitioner as expressed by the Counsel is that since the respondent nos.2 and 3 have entered into an agreement with the respondent no.4 privately and the purchasers of residential plots from the respondent no.4 have not been involved in any such decision, only the respondent no.4 shall be heard and not the petitioner while determining the compensation.
Learned counsel appearing for the Awas Avum Vikas Parishad has pointed out that till date the respondent no.4,E- Square Homes Private Ltd. is the recorded tenure holder insofar as Khasra No.1 and 3 of Sithauli Khurd are concerned, and, therefore, public notice has been issued to the respondent no.4, the recorded tenure holder for filing objections with regard to the proposed acquisition.
However, for determining of compensation, all interested persons including subsequent purchasers shall be heard in accordance with the provisions of the Act of 2013 read with Adhiniyam 1965.

This petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondent nos.2 and 3 as well as Additional District Magistrate (L/A) to give the petitioner proper opportunity of hearing in terms of the new Act of 2013 and the Adhiniyam of 1965 insofar as determining of compensation is concerned.
